The lower bound m_0 >= 6 follows from the Λ²U⊗Sym²C projection: each decomposable bivector projects to a rank-1 tensor with β rank ≤ 2, and q=I₃ has rank 3, requiring ≥ 2 terms per Λ²U direction, giving ≥ 6 total. This supersedes the analysis bound m_0 >= 7 from the A-wedge flattening.
